# CitadelDB Ultimate

CitadelDB Ultimate is a proof-backed private Postgres deployment and monitoring offer.

Public site:
- App-first database command center.
- SkyegateFS27 signup.
- Managed packages.
- Client-safe backup and restore proof language.

Signup posts to https://skyegatefs27-citadeldb.graylondonskyes.workers.dev/auth/signup and stores the returned Skyegate session/customer id locally.
